messages.author: 43e2e19dd6bd2992
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] GCRMA
parts:
Hi Jay,

ExonRmaPlm is a class for fitting the probe-level model, only. The
background correction and normalization are done before hand (see the
example on the help pages) -- there's not a single command that does the
whole 'vanilla' RMA processing. The standard background correction is
done with RmaBackgroundCorrection. I assume you are wanting a gc-RMA
background correction. There is a gcRMA background correction function
(GcRmaBackgroundCorrection). But I believe out-of-the-box gc correction
uses MM probes, so I don't know that you would want to use this function
for exon arrays. But I know nothing much about the function.

Note there are some 'MM' probes classified in Affy's cdf. I've never
understood what they are. I know that there are many probes on the array
for background correction that could be used for this purpose, and maybe
Affy has labeled them 'MM'. I've never had a chance to work it out. But
again, I think there would have to be a specially created function to do
this...

Best,
Elizabeth
